data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'kassios', meaning 'pure'. In Christian tradition, this name symbolizes spiritual cleansing and purification. The name Kassie carries the meaning “Pure, Cleansing” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Kassie usually hope their child will grow to embody pure, cleansing and live with faith, good character and purpose.

in_latin.long_meaning: In early Christian tradition, the name Kassia was associated with the Byzantine empress Kassia, who was known for her piety and charitable works. The cassia tree, from which the name is derived, symbolizes the fragrance of God's presence in our lives. In Christian tradition, the name Kassia represents a person who is gentle, compassionate, and wise like the empress, with a heart that is fragrant with love and devotion to God.
